title: Rosemary Pistachio Granola with Chilli and Juniper
changes_from_base: Savoury-leaning and quick: oats and pistachios are coated in honey melted with butter, fresh rosemary, chilli flakes and ground juniper and baked only 15-20 min, stirred once.
summary: A sophisticated granola with pistachios and fresh rosemary, warmed with chilli flakes and the earthiness of juniper, perfect with yoghurt or scattered on salads.
equipment: large rimmed baking tray (about 33 x 46 cm)
spice grinder or pestle and mortar

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 165 °C (145 °C fan); line a large rimmed baking tray with baking paper.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: In a large bowl, combine 270 g rolled oats and 250 g shelled pistachios.

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: In a small saucepan, gently melt 170 g runny honey and 42 g butter together; stir in 2 tbsp finely chopped fresh rosemary, 2 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tbsp finely ground juniper berries.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Pour the warm infused butter over the oats and pistachios and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Spread on the lined tray and bake for 15-20 min, stirring once at the halfway point, until golden.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely on the tray (it will crisp as it cools), then break into pieces.

steps.title: Store
steps.text: Once completely cool, transfer to an airtight container.

tips: Grind the juniper berries finely just before use so their fragrance is at its peak
Chop the fresh rosemary finely so it distributes evenly throughout the granola
This granola keeps for only 1 week due to the fresh herbs, so store carefully
storage: Keep in an airtight container for up to 1 week. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
